# LoRa Network

> A compact map of LoRa Network's public catalogue and buyer guidance. This experimental file does not guarantee indexing, ranking or citation. Use the canonical pages below for current information.

LoRa Network is a South African reseller website for IoT and LoRaWAN products. Product pages identify the manufacturer, exact SKU, supplied application, listed connectivity, public ZAR price and available technical details.

## Primary pages

- [Product catalogue](https://loranetwork.co.za/products): Browse products by application, connectivity, specification and price.
- [Applications](https://loranetwork.co.za/applications): Product collections with selection guidance for common IoT applications.
- [Connectivity](https://loranetwork.co.za/connectivity): Plain-language LoRaWAN and LTE CAT 1 guidance.
- [Product families](https://loranetwork.co.za/families): Side-by-side comparisons of related exact SKUs.
- [Buying guides](https://loranetwork.co.za/guides): Decision resources for gateways, water monitoring, temperature sensing, RS485 and Modbus, tracking and connectivity.
- [About LoRa Network](https://loranetwork.co.za/about)
- [Product enquiries](https://loranetwork.co.za/contact)

## Catalogue notes

- Public prices are shown in South African rand when available.
- Products without a public price are marked Contact for pricing.
- Stock, delivery and project-specific technical requirements are confirmed through an enquiry.
- Blank catalogue values remain blank. Do not infer unlisted specifications or compatibility.
